title: Fixed High Ported Shaft and Annular Wind Belt Cupola
description: One wholly newly authored complete raised cupola-style shaft-furnace static exterior. Four full long columns on finite broad feet carry a closed bottom and one continuous thick tall cylindrical shaft, with a genuine open upper mouth, broad high side charging-style opening and a distinct smaller low side port all entering the same empty chamber. A whole high open sill and separate lower open spout complete those two openings. The lower casing is encircled by one complete solid annular wind-belt exterior attached by four full radial branch exteriors, plus a short thick open side sleeve that terminates blindly at that solid belt. This is not the old closed rectangular firebox/solid stepped boiler with a blind short chimney, nor the long rising-vault kiln with its independent rear rectangular flue. No old barrel, silo, kiln or pipe mesh imported, scaled or renamed. One prop zero scenes; four constant opaque PBR roles, metres native Z up, centred whole horizontal envelope and four full ground soles. Empty illustrative exterior only: no furnace design, refractory layers, fuel, flame, metal, heat, combustion, smelting, internal tuyeres, connected air circuit, pressure, exhaust draft, material loading/discharge process, operation, emission control, manufacture, installation, structural capacity or safety performance. Rigging animation interaction not made or verified.
